subject: Discovery follow-up: scheduling demo & rotating time slots
messages:
From: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Jones <alex.jones@acme.com>, Sarah Liu <sarah.liu@acme.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-06-20T09:15:00-07:00
Subject: Discovery follow-up: scheduling demo & rotating time slots

Hi Alex / Sarah —

Great to meet you both on today's discovery call. Quick recap: Acme is evaluating inference at scale with strict latency and data residency needs across US/EU/APAC. You mentioned wanting a technical deep dive (model routing, dedicated vs private, and deployment patterns) and a live demo of the Redwood runtime with a sample workload.

Next steps I'd like to propose:
- 60-min technical deep dive + demo with our solutions engineers
- Ask: confirm attendees (engineering, security, procurement)
- Align on a recurring cadence with rotating time slots so stakeholders in APAC / EU / US can attend alternately

To make scheduling easier, attaching a short agenda and an .ics with rotating slot suggestions. Below are three rotating-week options; please pick which pattern works best for your team (or suggest alternatives):

Rotation A (Week 1 US-friendly):
- Mon 11:00 AM PT / 2:00 PM ET (45–60m)
Rotation B (Week 2 EU-friendly):
- Tue 3:00 PM CEST / 9:00 AM ET (45–60m)
Rotation C (Week 3 APAC-friendly):
- Wed 9:30 AM IST / 2:00 PM SGT (45–60m)

If helpful, we can do a fixed one-off demo first and then move to rotation. Calendly link is below for direct booking as well.

Attachments: redwood-demo-agenda.pdf (PDF, 2 pages), rotating-slots-calendar.ics
Links: https://calendly.com/redwood/demo-rotate

Thanks — I’ll coordinate internally once you confirm preferred rotation and attendee list.

Best,
Camila Reyes
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference
camila_reyes@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0192

From: Alex Jones <alex.jones@acme.com>

Cc: Sarah Liu <sarah.liu@acme.com>
Date: 2027-06-20T17:05:00+01:00
Subject: Re: Discovery follow-up: scheduling demo & rotating time slots

Camila — thanks for the follow-up and the clear options. Sarah and I reviewed internally. High level: we definitely want the technical deep dive and would like engineering + security (I will invite our infra lead, Priya) there.

Availability from our side over the next few weeks (CEST):
- Weekdays 14:00–17:00 CEST are generally good for engineering (that maps to 5:00–8:00 PT / 8:00–11:00 ET).
- Occasionally we can do 09:00–11:00 CEST if needed.

Rotation preference: Rotation B (EU-friendly weeks) would be easiest to start with since most of our core infra team is in Europe. However, we are open to alternating weeks if Redwood can offer evening ET/early morning CET slots for some weeks.

Attendees I will include: Alex Jones (me), Sarah Liu (IT Ops), Priya Natarajan (Infra Lead — will email calendar when I confirm), and procurement may join depending on the contract discussion.

Please propose 2–3 concrete date/time options next week and we’ll pick one. Also — can Marissa or Aditya include a brief note on what the demo will cover (model routing + KV cache + quantization profiles) so we can brief Priya?

Thanks,
Alex
Head of Engineering, Acme Corp
alex.jones@acme.com
+44 20 7946 0958

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>

Subject: Re: Discovery follow-up: scheduling demo & rotating time slots

Thanks Alex — copying Aditya (Solutions Engineering) who will run the session.

Quick note on scope for the demo (so you can share with Priya):
- Short 10-min architecture recap (how requests route between hosted/dedicated/private)
- Live demo (20–25 min): model routing, KV cache behavior with a small workload, and a quantized model run to show latency/cost differences
- Q&A/customization (15–20 min): deployment patterns, SLAs, and next step options (POC vs pilot)

Concretely proposing these slots next week (all shown with both local and converted times):
- Option 1: Tue 2027-06-22 15:00 CEST / Tue 2027-06-22 09:00 ET / Tue 2027-06-22 06:00 PT (45–60m)
- Option 2: Wed 2027-06-23 10:00 CEST / Wed 2027-06-23 04:00 ET / Wed 2027-06-23 01:00 PT (note: early PT)
- Option 3: Thu 2027-06-24 16:00 CEST / Thu 2027-06-24 10:00 ET / Thu 2027-06-24 07:00 PT

If you confirm Option 1 or 3 we can schedule a recurring invites with the rotation pattern: Week 1 EU-friendly, Week 2 US-friendly, Week 3 APAC-friendly, then repeat. I’ve attached the agenda and an .ics that seeds the rotating pattern; Camila will update HubSpot with the chosen slot.

Attachments referenced above: redwood-demo-agenda.pdf, rotating-slots-calendar.ics

—Marissa
Senior Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference
